description: Heap allocator with tcache. Overflow a chunk to corrupt the next pointer and gain an arbitrary allocation.
explanation: Tcache freelist poisoning turns a heap overflow into arbitrary write-what-where after a controlled allocation. Confirm glibc version and tcache counts before assuming the classic attack works.
solve_steps: Map chunk layout and overflow offset
Corrupt tcache fd to target address
Allocate until the poisoned chunk is returned
Verify write with a non-destructive probe first
